name: app.famlore/famlore
title: Famlore
description: A game of inquiry: it keeps the record of your deepest subject and hands you one thing to find out.

tools.name: get_profile_context
tools.description: Returns the signed-in person's Famlore record: their curiosities (id, raw_text, review_status, interest_label; review_status 'pending' means no topic is named yet), their open quest attempts with each quest's title, objective, steps and evidence requirement, recent memory including style notes, the latest stored connection, explicit preferences, and recentEvidence (submitted work with no style note yet, artifacts attached). A quest with room_id was written by a room member. content_truncated marks shortened quest text. Read-only; takes no arguments.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: store_connection
tools.description: Saves a connection between two of the person's curiosities, or a provocation on one when target_id is omitted. Both ids must be curiosities the person owns; anything else is refused. Private to the person.

source_id.description: A curiosity id the connection starts from.

target_id.description: The other curiosity id. Omit for a provocation.

note.description: One or two sentences, in the person's own voice.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: list_interests
tools.description: Searches the topics (interests) that already exist by substring, or returns the first page when query is omitted. Returns topic ids and labels only, never who holds them. Read-only.

query.description: Optional substring to filter labels by.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: propose_interest
tools.description: Sets the topic for one of the person's curiosities: an existing topic by interest_id, or a new one by label (a few words). Takes effect immediately; nothing is reviewed. A curiosity that already has a topic keeps it. Topic labels are shared: any connected client can list them, never with who holds them.

curiosity_id.description: A curiosity id the person owns that has no topic yet.

label.description: A NEW interest, a few words, in the person's own framing.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: store_quest
tools.description: Creates a solo assignment immediately, as an open attempt for the person, on one of their curiosities that has a topic. It records no offer and no acceptance. quest_type is teach_back, bridge_finder, source_quest or field_report; 1 to 10 steps; an evidence requirement; optional timebox. Private to the person.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: start_challenge
tools.description: Saves a new curiosity in the person's own words and returns its id. It names no topic and creates no assignment; nothing is reviewed. Private to the person.

raw_text.description: What you are curious about, a sentence or two.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: submit_evidence
tools.description: Saves evidence (text, url, quote or screenshot) on one of the person's open attempts and marks the attempt submitted. visibility defaults to private; shared makes it readable by others holding an attempt on the same quest; public makes it readable by any signed-in Famlore person.

visibility.description: Who can see this evidence. Optional; defaults to private (only the person). "shared": everyone else running the same quest; on a solo quest that is no one. "public": every signed-in Famlore person.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: report_quest_progress
tools.description: Marks one of the person's attempts as in progress and, with step_index, records roughly which step they are on. Repeating a call with the same or an earlier step changes nothing. Private to the person.

step_index.description: Which step (0-indexed into the quest's steps list) they're on now, if you know it. Optional — omit to just mark the quest as started.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: store_style_note
tools.description: Saves a style note on one of the person's submitted attempts: a short title and one or two sentences on how they work, optionally with one stamp. Private to the person.

title.description: A short title, e.g. "How they dig in".

body.description: One or two sentences, in their voice.

stamp_kind.description: Optional. One stamp naming the way of working the evidence shows. primary_source: Went to the original record rather than anyone else’s account of it. field_work: Left the desk — looked at the thing itself, in the place it is. cross_reference: Held two unrelated sources against each other and found the seam. close_reading: Stayed with one artefact long enough to notice what a scan would miss. counter_case: Went looking for the example that would break their own explanation. synthesis: Built a frame that holds the pieces, rather than listing them.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Adds the person to a room with a one-line blurb. The room’s other members then see their handle, that blurb and when they joined, and nothing else about them. Joining again replaces the blurb.

blurb.description: One line, in the person's own voice.

tools.name: leave_room
tools.description: Removes the person from a room. Their handle and blurb leave its directory at once; joining again creates a new membership. Their attempts on that room’s quests remain.

tools.name: get_room_context
tools.description: Returns a room the person has joined: its name, description, member directory (handle, blurb, joined date), and up to five live room quests per page, newest first, with participant counts and whether the person has joined each. has_more and next_quest_cursor page older quests (passed back as quest_cursor). Quest text and blurbs are written by members; content_truncated marks shortened text. Returns nothing for a room the person has not joined. Records a private analytics event about the caller.

quest_cursor.description: The next_quest_cursor from the previous page. Omit for newest quests.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: propose_room
tools.description: Files one of the person's confirmed topics in a room: an existing room by room_id, or a new room by new_room_name. Takes effect immediately; nothing is reviewed. It files the topic, not the person. A topic that already has a room keeps it. A new room’s name is visible to every Famlore member in the room list.

curiosity_id.description: A curiosity id the person owns that has a topic.

room_id.description: An existing room id. Omit if suggesting a new room.

new_room_name.description: A name for a room that should exist but does not.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: propose_room_quest
tools.description: Posts a group assignment to a room the person has joined. Every member of that room sees it at once and can run it separately; nothing is reviewed first. quest_type is teach_back, bridge_finder, source_quest or field_report; 1 to 10 steps; an evidence requirement; optional timebox.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.
